title: Life Skills Training for Prison Inmates
what_it_is: Life Skills Training for Prison Inmates

sections.label: Prison Service community partner programmes
sections.summary: Singapore Prison Service works with community partners and voluntary welfare organisations on inmate programmes covering life skills, family programmes and drug abuse intervention.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Singapore Prison Service works with a number of community partners and voluntary welfare organisations to run programmes for inmates that incorporate life skills, such as communication, stress management, conflict resolution and financial management.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: One example is the structured family programmes run by Fei Yue Community Services and Lakeside Family Services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Another example is the drug abuse intervention programme run by Touch Community Services, which motivates inmates with drug antecedents to change.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: More than 35,000 training places were offered to inmates in the last five years.
